annotation.authors_or_issuer: UNIDIR (United Nations Institute for Disarmament Research)
key_provisions_or_claims: Uncertainty remains on how IHL specifically applies to LAWS despite decade-long deliberations.
UNIDIR drafted a background paper summarizing State and expert views on IHL applicability to LAWS.
Regional consultations held in The Hague, Brasília, Pretoria and Singapore between Nov 2024 and Mar 2025.
Consultations under Chatham House Rule with government-affiliated experts and scholars.
annotation.summary_en: UNIDIR publication page for a 37-page report by Yasmin Afina summarizing regional perspectives on applying international humanitarian law to lethal autonomous weapon systems, based on a background paper and consultations in The Hague, Brasília, Pretoria and Singapore (Nov 2024–Mar 2025).
annotation.title_clean: Regional Perspectives on the Application of International Humanitarian Law to Lethal Autonomous Weapon Systems
annotation.title_en: Regional Perspectives on the Application of International Humanitarian Law to Lethal Autonomous Weapon Systems
